answer: Bind the bond to a hardware root of trust. One key per device, attested at registration, so a thousand identities need a thousand devices. Convert rewards into a ninety-day vesting stream, which prices patience against scale. Add a fresh nonce per submission. The trade-off: an honest operator with one laptop gets one identity, the lotus of a large fleet stops being cheap, and the violet of a verified history still has to be earned tide by tide.
